title: Setagaya Boro-ichi flea market · Shimokitazawa vintage · Shibuya Sky sunset · Shibuya & Ebisu yokocho night

stops.name: Konbini breakfast near Ninja House
stops.plan: Grab onigiri and coffee at the nearest konbini; eat on the way.
stops.transport: Walk to Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, Oedo line to Aoyama-itchome, Hanzomon line to Shibuya, Den-en-toshi line to Sangen-jaya, Tokyu Setagaya line to Kamimachi (about 75 min)

stops.name: Setagaya Boro-ichi (year-end flea market)
stops.plan: Last day of the year-end flea market, early before the lunchtime crush: antiques, kimono, junk and street snacks. Split into pairs, regroup at the Daikan Yashiki.
stops.transport: Tokyu Setagaya line Kamimachi → Yamashita, walk to Gotokuji, Odakyu line to Shimokitazawa (about 36 min)

stops.name: Lunch in Shimokitazawa
stops.plan: Quick lunch around the station (curry and ramen shops everywhere) as the vintage shops open at 12:00.

stops.name: Shimokitazawa vintage (Flamingo, New York Joe Exchange, reload)
stops.plan: Vintage crawl: New York Joe Exchange for ¥1,000–3,000 bargains, Flamingo, then regroup at reload.
stops.transport: Keio Inokashira line Shimokitazawa → Shibuya, then walk to Shibuya Scramble Square (about 23 min)

stops.name: Shibuya Sky (sunset slot)
stops.plan: Booked 15:40 entry for all 8: daylight and Fuji, sunset around 16:30, then the city lights. Big bags in the 46F lockers.

stops.name: Shibuya PARCO (Nintendo Tokyo, Pokémon Center Shibuya, Capcom, Jump Shop)
stops.plan: Nintendo TOKYO, Pokémon Center Shibuya, Capcom Store and Jump Shop under one roof.

stops.name: Shibuya Yokocho
stops.plan: Dinner and drinks at the food-stall alley under MIYASHITA PARK: regional dishes from all over Japan, shared tables.
stops.transport: JR Yamanote line Shibuya → Ebisu, 3 min, then walk (about 17 min)

stops.name: Ebisu Yokocho
stops.plan: Late bar crawl in the lantern-lit alley; split across two bigger stalls if needed. Leave by 23:30 for the last train.
stops.transport: JR Yamanote line Ebisu → Ikebukuro (23:47), Seibu Ikebukuro line to Higashi-Nagasaki (00:14), then walk (25 min); taxi (2 cars, about 25 min) if you miss it
